columns.semanticLimits: c marker indicates cancellation; no cash-refund proof
Free text is unnecessary; no content review performed
Date/time encoding, date basis and timezone need observation
GBP unit price; tax inclusion and monetary precision unresolved
Pseudonymous identifier; not needed for initial product/date/amount checks
Customer attribute is unnecessary for initial checks

exactDecimalPolicy: Do not coerce UnitPrice, Quantity or Excel numeric date cells to IEEE-754 values; retain exact source lexical value and cell type; dates require an explicit calendar/profile before conversion.
admissionPrerequisites: Permitted transfer capability; fresh source request/receipt, not a retry of this stopped attempt.
Record raw artifact hash/byte count without retaining an unnecessary unreviewed raw workbook; approve bounded transient/quarantine handling first.
Inspect package parts, worksheet names, actual headers/types, hidden sheets and external links before projection; reject unexpected contact or other identifying columns.
Drop CustomerID, Country and Description before retained corpus data; review remaining record linkage. Do not claim anonymization.
Record parser/build version, source-cell receipts, retained projection hash and byte count, rows/exclusions and schema fingerprint.
Preserve cancellation/negative-value states; refuse money/revenue claims lacking tax, status, date, units and independent source-total evidence.
